args.message: I took all orders with status 'ok' (4,410 orders, $294,707.55 in total) and linked each order to its customer's region. North brings in 33.2% of 'ok' revenue, South 31.6%, East 20.2% and West 14.6%. The 16 orders whose customer has no known region make up their own group (region shown as null) and account for 0.4%. The shares add up to 1.
